label: Florida Drinking Water Treatment Plant Operator, Class C (DEP)
purpose: Practice questions for the Florida Department of Environmental Protection Drinking Water Treatment Plant Operator Class C examination. Original items in US units, written at general-practice depth from the subject areas DEP publishes for the Class C exam. DEP lists subject areas only, with no weights and no objectives, so this is not an official blueprint and carries no Florida-specific legal limits.
reviewIntro: 150 original practice questions: 114 conceptual and 36 calculations, in US customary units. DEP's June 2026 handbook lists the Class C drinking-water-treatment subject areas (aeration; source-water characteristics; clarification and sedimentation; coagulation and flocculation; corrosion control; disinfection and disinfectant byproducts; distribution; filtration; facility operation and maintenance; equipment evaluation and operation; iron and manganese control; laboratory sampling, analysis and interpretation; mathematics; safety and security; regulations; reservoir and well-field management; softening; taste and odor control; waste handling and disposal; water process) with no weights and no objectives, so the questions are spread across those areas by judgement and kept at general entry-level practice. No Florida rule numbers, limits or deadlines are tested. Class A, B and D, wastewater and distribution content are excluded. This is the first release size; more questions can be added later at the end of the source files. This is a local content package, not proof of a production import.

FLHB: Florida DEP, Operator Certification Program Handbook (revised June 2026), Class C drinking-water treatment examination subject areas
